stage_interpretation.capture_cycle: capture_page start for page n to capture_page start for page n+1; 11 complete cycles/run; last-page-to-run-end is partial and excluded
stage_interpretation.measurement_gap: residual wall contains state/polling, CDP and scheduling not assigned to an exclusive child; progress-file write occurs after p1 commit
